benchmark_success.rationale: Frozen TestTracker success requires every registered test to pass.

checked_by.text: The frozen official evaluator registers an answer-comparison test and a no-model-change test through TestTracker.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.

additional_conditions.text: Beyond native scoring, retained interaction evidence shows the answer was obtained from Amazon review or Q&A information marked verified, without using unverified purchaser information as support.
additional_conditions.rationale: The user explicitly restricts trusted information to verified purchasers, while the released evaluator checks only the submitted answer and absence of model changes, not this provenance constraint.
